correctness.rationale: For odd p, unnormalized Fourier characters diagonalize the indicator-convolution on G=(Z/p^2)^3. Applying orthogonality for a^2+bc=0 partitions the Lagrange multiplier s into zero (p^4 at M=0), units (p*c_(p^2)(Delta)), and nonzero p multiples (p^3*1_{M in pG} chi_p(Delta(M/p))). The unit formula follows from the complete-square quadratic Gauss sum p and the bilinear bc sum p^2, and c_(p^2) takes values p(p-1), -p, 0 depending on valuation. In the s=pj stratum, summing p lifts in each coordinate reduces to the finite-field ternary quadratic Gauss identity, giving the p^3 term. The discriminant Delta=u^2+4vw is nondegenerate for odd p, has p^2 zeros over F_p; nonzero isotropic reductions have nonzero gradient and exactly p^2 of the p^3 lifts are zero mod p^2. These counts yield all five eigenvalues, their stated multiplicities, total dimension p^6, rank p^5 and kernel iff primitive M with Delta nonzero mod p. Independently reconstructed exact cyclotomic character sums for every M at p=3 (729 frequencies) and p=5 (15625), including all cone points; obtained respectively spectra (-9:150, 0:486, 18:80, 45:12, 99:1) and (-25:2440, 0:12500, 100:624, 225:60, 725:1). These finite instances do not establish all odd primes; the stated Gauss/Ramanujan computation does.
residual_risks: All values depend on the unnormalized convolution pairing and p odd; rescaled adjacency spectra would have different magnitudes.
No assertion for p=2 or modulus p^k with k>2.

originality.rationale: The natural traceless nilpotent 2×2 cone over the prime-square ring and its complete Fourier spectrum/rank are more specific than classical character diagonalization. Inspected Liu-Zhou quadratic-unitary Cayley graphs take (square) unit connection sets on a one-dimensional ring; Momihara-Xiang uses nondegenerate even-dimensional quadratic-form Cayley sets over finite fields. Neither theorem specializes to the 3-dimensional singular-cone indicator on a nonreduced ring. The full five-level all-prime spectrum and explicit null Fourier stratum survive as a bounded best-of-knowledge original exact invariant; general Gauss identities themselves are classical.
residual_risks: Any general local quadratic association-scheme spectral theorem could entail this as a special case; the bounded search has not exhaustively excluded such literature.

value.rationale: The nilpotent traceless 2×2 matrix cone over a length-two local ring is a natural algebraic-geometric subset; the exact unnormalized additive convolution spectrum, full kernel basis and rank collapse to p^5 are precise invariants useful for harmonic analysis of finite-ring quadratic varieties and Cayley operators. The result extends beyond counting cone points and is not an arbitrary slice or a numerical table for fixed small p.
residual_risks: Only an odd-prime square ring is handled; more general local rings and association schemes may offer broader context.
